speaker: Doctor
text: I see you have a longstanding pruritic rash with numbness and tingling on your palms. To narrow this down, can you describe the specific pattern of the rash and whether the skin feels thickened or tight? Also, have you noticed any other symptoms like joint pain, fever, or photosensitivity?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your occupation with rice farming and livestock, do you have direct contact with soil, plants, or animals, and are you aware of any exposure to specific herbs, insects, or animal products? Additionally, has anyone in your family ever developed a similar rash or neurological symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Leprosy (Hansen's Disease). REQUEST IMAGES: Skin and peripheral nerve imaging to confirm hypopigmented macules and nerve thickening.
